SDG India Index 2023-24: Sustainable Development Goals Progress Report

July 12, 2024 Vertical: Sustainable Development Goals (SDG)

The SDG India Index 2023-24 measures the progress achieved by all States and Union Territories across 16 Sustainable Development Goals.

India's overall SDG score improved to 74 in 2023-24 from 66 in 2020-21, driven by significant progress in Goal 1 (No Poverty), Goal 6 (Clean Water and Sanitation), and Goal 7 (Affordable and Clean Energy).

Key Performance Highlights

  • Top Performing States: Kerala and Uttarakhand with composite index score of 79.
  • Fastest Movers: Uttar Pradesh (jump of 25 points since 2018), J&K, and Punjab.
  • Front Runner Category: 32 States/UTs now positioned in the Front Runner bracket (score 65-99).
